mods.name: Kappa
mods.description: This mod adds OptiFine capes (correctly), and is aimed for use in snapshots. It's also meant to be very light and to modify very little so it doesn't upset server moderators, or so it doesn't get broken very easily (which upsets me!).

releases.notes:

- Fix a crash when opening the skin options screen.

mods.name: Kappa
mods.description: This mod adds OptiFine capes (correctly), and is aimed for use in snapshots. It's also meant to be very light and to modify very little so it doesn't upset server moderators, or so it doesn't get broken very easily (which upsets me!).

releases.notes:
This is a bugfix for Kappa:

- Fixed a crash that would happen when a server had too many players with the same name at the same time.
- Use the HTTPS server at `optifine.net` when available. If that is unavailable, the original HTTP server at `s.optifine.net` server will be used in case of outages.

This version was compiled against 21w37a for Java 16 and has been tested to work successfully with:
- **1.18.1**
- 1.18.2 Snapshots: 22w03a, 22w05a, 22w06a, 22w07a
- 1.18.2 Pre-releases and Release Candidates: 1.18.2-pre1, 1.18.2-pre2, 1.18.2-pre3, 1.18.2-rc1
- **1.18.2**
- 1.19 Snapshots: 1.19_deep_dark_experimental_snapshot-1, 22w11a, 22w12a, 22w13a, 22w14a, 22w15a
- April Fool's Snapshots: **22w13oneBlockAtATime**

Additionally, the changes in this release do not touch Minecraft exclusive things, meaning that, *theoretically*, this release should be binary compatible with every Minecraft version that [Kappa v3.0.1](https://github.com/Hibiii/Kappa/releases/tag/v3.0.1) is compatible with.

releases.notes:
This update is a major refactor to Kappa:
- Reduced considerably the codebase.
- Relicensed under Unlicense.
- Made it so Kappa uses the vanilla capes more effectively.
- Updated Java compatibility to Java 16.
- Removed self IGN display feature as it was out of scope.
- Fabric API is still not needed.
- Better Modmenu compatibility.

This version was compiled against 1.17-pre1 for Java 16 and has been tested to work successfully with:
